title: framework.yaml in the framework repo: plugin name and framework-level user decisions
description: Split from framework-config on 2026-10-27 (N-D8). source_format, selftest.sample_repos, versioning.mode, codex.distribution and the other knobs without an implemented alternative are constants.

decisions.description: framework-level user-owned decisions (framework repo only): U3 author confirmation scope before commit in a local Claude Code editing session (decided B on 2026-10-14 with confirm_scope and self_tests), U4 review criteria files (decided C on 2026-10-14: one file code_review.md referenced from AGENTS.md, REVIEW.md copy opt-in via review.managed_code_review_copy, asked at init as a plain yes/no with default No since C-058). U5 (interim behavior while U2 is null) is obsolete since U2 was decided on 2026-10-14 and is not recorded here
